name: Southard Estate Planning

hero.alt: Katherine Southard of Southard Estate Planning by the harbor in Setauket

maps: Southard Estate Planning, 175 Main St, Setauket, NY 11733

intro.text: Katherine Southard started Southard Estate Planning to help people protect their families, and to make estate planning accessible to everyone, regardless of net worth or life circumstances. She has over 17 years of experience in estate planning and estate administration, and is admitted to practice in New York and California. She builds each plan around your family, your health care wishes and your assets, and explains what every document means.
intro.quote: Your estate plan is about your family.

services.d: Decide who makes decisions and who inherits. Trusts can keep your affairs private and help avoid probate.
Name who makes financial and medical decisions for you if you can't.
Plan who would care for minor children and how their assets would be managed.
Guidance for families through probate and estate administration.
Periodic reviews of your plan, with a team of financial advisors and accountants when needed.

reviews.text: A quick review helps your neighbors take the first step on their own plan.

faq: Do I need an estate plan if I don't have a lot of assets?
Katherine believes every person deserves a well thought out estate plan, whether you are single, married or in a committed relationship, regardless of net worth.
175 Main Street, Suite 5, Setauket, NY 11733. Hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM.

final.text: Call the Setauket office or send a message to get started.
